awaiting: Phase-1 external wet-lab chi validation on N≥15 polymer-solvent pairs sampled from the tested applicability-domain interior for each of water, ethanol, chloroform; verify empirical coverage matches marginal KPI within ±5%
Phase-1 solvent generalization test: measure model behaviour on a 4th and 5th solvent (e.g. toluene, methyl-ethyl-ketone) with a chi ground truth from an independent source
capability: Distribution-free calibrated Flory-Huggins chi prediction intervals + quantitative applicability-domain attestation for coating solvent selection. Three canonical solvents (water, ethanol, chloroform) evaluated per-polymer on the Open Macromolecular Genome (OMG) PhysicalProperties dataset (Xie, Rodriguez, Jackson et al 2024; TheJacksonLab v1.0), 98,506 scaffold-safe sampled polymers, 7,298 unique Bemis-Murcko generic scaffolds. Split-conformal (Papadopoulos et al 2002) with GroupKFold scaffold-safe train/cal/test partition; Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto AD (OECD 2007 Principle 3); per-solvent per-alpha coverage and width; per-AD-quintile stratification; hostile-null y-shuffle falsifiability. Grants no scoring, batch-release, manufacturing-qualification, or optimizer authority.

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.applicability_domain_rule: AD_score(x_new) = max over training scaffolds s of TanimotoSimilarity(Morgan(x_new), Morgan(s)). Low AD score flags out-of-distribution chemistry.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.feature_matrix: Morgan(r=2, 512 bits) ⊕ 16 rdkit descriptors (MW, LogP, TPSA, HBA, HBD, RotB, AromRings, HeavyAtoms, NAtomsN/O/S/Hal, FCsp3, NumRings, AromHetero, AliphaticRings) — 528 total features
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule_per_solvent: For a new polymer x: return interval [ŷ - q̂_α, ŷ + q̂_α] where q̂_α = ⌈(1-α)(n_cal+1)⌉-th order statistic of |y_i - ŷ(x_i)| on the scaffold-disjoint calibration set. Marginal coverage ≥ 1-α by Papadopoulos et al 2002 under exchangeability.

metrics.name: marginal_conformal_coverage_at_alpha_010_meets_target_water
metrics.note: Fraction of 11,003 scaffold-safe held-out polymer-water chi observations whose values fall inside the split-conformal prediction interval at α=0.10. Coverage guarantee ≥ 0.90 by Papadopoulos et al 2002 under exchangeability.

metrics.name: marginal_conformal_coverage_at_alpha_020_meets_target_water
metrics.note: Same guarantee at α=0.20 for solvent water.

metrics.name: hostile_null_shuffle_coverage_at_alpha_010_meets_worst_case_floor_water
metrics.note: Falsifiability check: y values for solvent water shuffled with np.random.default_rng(0). Coverage guarantee is P(y_new ∈ interval) ≥ 1-α = 0.90 marginally under exchangeability (Papadopoulos et al 2002). Observed 0.8972 on n_test=11,003; finite-sample variance is √[p(1-p)/n] ≈ 0.0029. Worst-case 1-2α = 0.80 floor is the conservative bound. Passing this floor + high empirical coverage confirms exchangeability preservation and validates the coverage claim's structural correctness.

metrics.name: hostile_null_shuffle_coverage_at_alpha_010_within_1_sigma_of_asymptotic_target_water
metrics.note: Tighter check: is observed hostile-null coverage within 1σ of the asymptotic target 0.90? 1σ finite-sample deficit at n=11,003 is ~0.0029. A pass here is stronger evidence that the coverage guarantee is achieved in the finite-sample regime.

metrics.name: hostile_null_width_inflates_over_real_signal_water
metrics.note: Hostile-null / real-signal median interval width ratio at α=0.10. A ratio > 1 shows the base learner extracts real signal from features beyond the coverage guarantee alone.

metrics.name: worst_ad_quintile_coverage_at_alpha_010_meets_worst_case_floor_water
metrics.note: Worst per-AD-quintile coverage at α=0.10 for solvent water. Soft floor 1-2α=0.80 (conditional coverage is not theoretically guaranteed but a low value would prompt AD-restricted use).

metrics.name: test_r2_positive_scaffold_safe_water
metrics.note: Base learner test R² for solvent water on 11,003 scaffold-safe held-out polymers. Positive → beats mean baseline.

population: OMG PhysicalProperties v1.0 (Xie, Rodriguez, Jackson et al 2024) active-learning batches 0-3 + test = 98,506 polymers with DFT+COSMO-RS computed Flory-Huggins chi against water, ethanol, and chloroform. Scaffold-safe partition: train 39,556 (4,378 scaffolds), cal 47,947 (1,460 scaffolds), test 11,003 (1,460 scaffolds). Hostile-null: same features and splits, y shuffled once with np.random.default_rng(0).
split_methodology: 60/20/20 scaffold-safe train / calibration / test partition by unique Bemis-Murcko generic scaffold; random permutation under np.random.default_rng(seed=0); assertion of pairwise scaffold-disjointness at construction. Conformal calibration on scaffold-disjoint held-out polymers; empirical marginal coverage measurement on further scaffold-disjoint held-out.
